$comment: The agent contract, captured from the committed pages at 561e4c4 before any tool was restyled. Every tool slice must keep it. test/agent-contract.test.js runs each page's scripts in node (test/page-sandbox.js) and checks the WebMCP tools it registers (names, descriptions, input schemas, annotations), the URL parameters it reads and the storage keys it touches against this file, plus the URL templates and the labels llms.txt quotes. check-browser.js runs the pages in Chrome and checks the read-only outputs, the llms.txt example outputs (sha256), that each example link shows what the tool shows for the same input and the answer its `summary` names (the summary must also be what the tool returns), and what each prefilled link in `prefilled` loads or does. `urlParamNotes` names parameters a page reads that llms.txt does not list as URL parameters, with the reason. Change it only together with llms.txt, on purpose.

webmcp.name: assess_life_balance
webmcp.description: Sort eight life areas (health, work, family, spirituality, creativity, relationships, financial, rest) into Invest, Maintain, Rebalance, or Release from how much each matters (importance 1-6) and how it is going (satisfaction 1-6), with 3.5 as the midpoint, and name the one area to focus on next. Rate as many areas as you know; all eight gives the full matrix. Returns each area's quadrant, the priority, and a link that reopens the same result. Also shows the result on the page.

webmcp.name: find_native_plants
webmcp.description: Find California native plants for a California ZIP code and sun exposure, optionally filtered by water needs, wildlife, and care. Returns each plant (name, layer, height, sun, water, bloom, wildlife supported) plus local nurseries and a link to the same result. Also shows the result on the page.

sun.description: Direct sun per day: full_shade (<2 h), part_shade (2-4 h), part_sun (4-6 h), full_sun (6+ h). Defaults to part_sun.

water.description: Keep plants with any of these water needs.

wildlife.description: Keep plants that support any of these.

care.description: easy = easy to grow; deer = deer resistant.

webmcp.name: get_saved_native_plants
webmcp.description: List the plants the person has saved to My Garden in this browser.

webmcp.name: fill_memorial_pamphlet
webmcp.description: Fill in the memorial pamphlet on this page: a letter or A4 sheet, printed both sides and folded in half, to hand out at a funeral or memorial service. Only the fields you pass change, and the person sees the preview update. Photos and the PDF download stay with the person: tell them to add photos if they want, then click Generate PDF.

full_name.description: Full name of the person who died (required before export, up to 80 characters).

dates.description: Dates line under the name, e.g. "March 3, 1942 - May 18, 2026".

cover_title.description: Small title above the photo. Default "In Loving Memory".

obituary.description: Short obituary or life summary, up to 1,800 characters. Blank lines separate paragraphs.

order_of_service.description: Parts of the service in order, one per item, e.g. ["Prelude", "Opening Prayer", "Eulogy - Daniel Whitman"]. Up to 2,000 characters in all.

closing_line.description: Short line on the back cover, e.g. "Forever in our hearts."

template.description: classic: centered serif cover. modern: dark cover, bolder name.

webmcp.name: get_memorial_pamphlet_draft
webmcp.description: Read the memorial pamphlet as it is currently filled in on this page, plus the allowed templates, paper sizes, and field length limits.

webmcp.name: list_service_of_life_options
webmcp.description: List what this Service of Life Builder supports: service types and the sections each includes, tradition profiles, component types and their fields, suggested Scripture readings, and ready-made prayer texts.

webmcp.name: get_service_of_life_draft
webmcp.description: Read the order of service as it currently stands on this page: service type, tradition, name, date, place, officiant, and every section with its components.

webmcp.name: set_service_of_life_details
webmcp.description: Set the basics of the order of service on this page. Only the fields you pass change. Changing service_type keeps the content of sections the new type shares; if it would remove sections that hold content, it refuses unless allow_removing_content is true, so ask the person first.

name_of_deceased.description: Full name, as it should appear on the order of service.

allow_removing_content.description: Only after the person agrees: lets a service_type change remove sections that hold content.

webmcp.name: add_service_of_life_component
webmcp.description: Add one item (a prayer or other text, a reading, music, a tribute, or a silence) to a section of the order of service on this page. Adding to a switched-off optional section switches it on. Use list_service_of_life_options for section ids and fields.

section_id.description: A section_id from get_service_of_life_draft, e.g. "gathering" or "word".

fields.description: text_block: title, role (leader|all|reader|soloist|silent), body, rubric. reading_ref: label, citation, reader_name, full_text. music_item: title, kind (hymn|song|instrumental), details, performer. tribute_slot: speaker, prompt, time_limit_minutes (1-30). silence: label, duration_seconds (5-300). Unknown fields are ignored.

position.description: Where in the section, 0 = first. Defaults to the end.

starter_texts.title: Welcome
starter_texts.body: We gather to remember [Name], to give thanks for their life, and to hold one another in grief and hope.

starter_texts.title: Opening Prayer
starter_texts.body:
God of mercy, be near to us in our sorrow. Give us comfort, courage, and a clear love for one another.
Amen.

starter_texts.title: Commendation
starter_texts.body:
We entrust [Name] to your mercy, O God: receive them into your care, and sustain all who mourn.
Amen.

starter_texts.title: Blessing
starter_texts.body:
May the God of peace, who brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, make you complete in everything good.
Amen.

starter_texts.title: Dismissal
starter_texts.body:
Go in peace to love and serve the Lord.

Thanks be to God.

list_service_of_life_options.notes: [Name] in any text is replaced with the name of the deceased in the preview.

webmcp.name: get_memorial_preferences_worksheet
webmcp.description: Returns the questions on the one-page printable Memorial Preferences Worksheet (gathering type, music, prayers, readings, people, special touches, own words) as structured JSON, plus a link that opens it ready to print.

webmcp.name: print_memorial_preferences_worksheet
webmcp.description: Opens the browser print dialog for the one-page Memorial Preferences Worksheet. Only the worksheet prints.

get_memorial_preferences_worksheet.title: My Wishes for My Memorial Service
get_memorial_preferences_worksheet.intro: Take your time. There are no wrong answers, and it is fine to leave anything blank.

sections.heading: 1. The kind of gathering I would like
checkboxes: I trust my family to decide
fields: Held at (a church, outdoors, a favorite place):
Led by (a pastor or priest, a friend, a family member):

sections.heading: 2. Music
sections.hint: Hymns or songs you love, and who you’d like to sing or play them, if you have someone in mind.

sections.heading: 3. Prayers
sections.hint: Prayers you would like said aloud (the Lord’s Prayer, a table grace, a blessing you love).

sections.heading: 4. Scripture or sacred readings
sections.hint: Passages that have meant something to you, from anywhere in the Bible, not only the familiar Psalms.

sections.heading: 5. Other readings
sections.hint: A poem, a letter, a passage from a favorite book. Anything you would like read aloud.

sections.heading: 6. People I would like to take part
sections.hint: Who might speak, share a memory, read, or serve as a pallbearer. Being asked is a kindness.

sections.heading: 7. Special touches
sections.hint: Flowers or a donation in your name? A favorite photograph? Anything that feels like you.

sections.heading: 8. In my own words
sections.hint: Anything else you want the people planning this to know.

closing: When you have finished, keep this page somewhere safe, and tell someone you trust where to find it.
For the family: when the time comes, type these answers into the free planning tools at bensiverly.com to print an order of service.

urlParamNotes.context: readUrl() reads it with the other four; llms.txt documents context only as a score_decision input.

webmcp.name: score_decision
webmcp.description: Rank 2-6 options with a weighted decision matrix. Give the options, 2-10 criteria with a weight from 1 (nice to have) to 5 (critical), and a 1-5 score for every option on every criterion (1 poor fit, 5 strong fit). Each option's total is the sum of weight x score; percentage is that total over the best possible. Returns the ranking with the math per criterion and a link that reopens the same result. Also shows the result on the page.

decision.description: The decision in a few words, e.g. "Take the new job or stay put".

weight.description: 1 nice to have, 2 somewhat important, 3 important (default), 4 very important, 5 critical.

scores.description: One row per option, in options order. Each row holds one 1-5 score per criterion, in criteria order.

webmcp.name: list_decision_factors
webmcp.description: List the suggested decision criteria by category (financial, time, relationships, health, growth, values, practical, emotional) and what each weight and score number means. Use it to help someone choose criteria before calling score_decision; any other criterion name works too.

edition.note: Night or Day, remembered by the masthead words on every redesigned page.
